articles.title: Bitcoin gives back its run at $85,000 as Tesla and Meta fail to calm AI nerves
articles.snippet: BTC broke through its $84,000 ceiling late Wednesday, then slid back to the $82,500 support analysts are watching as tech futures fell.

articles.title: Why centralized exchanges refuse to list legacy crypto tokens without explicit SEC immunity
articles.snippet: Vault12 raised $17.45 million selling VGT in 2018 and says it met or dropped every promise, yet the token has never traded on a centralized exchange.

articles.title: Meta Creates Non-Voting Stock to Fund AI Buildout, Keeping Zuckerberg in Control
articles.snippet: Meta will hand shareholders a free non-voting share for every share they own in January, giving it a way to raise equity for AI spending without diluting Zuckerberg's 60.6% vote.

articles.title: Oil Climbs Above $111 as AI Stocks Slide, Dragging the S&P 500 and Global Markets With Them
articles.snippet: Brent crude hit a five-month high while Nvidia, Meta and chip stocks fell, pulling Asia's benchmark indexes down by up to 3.5% a week after South Korea's Kospi plunged 7.57%.
